definitions.explanation: One's place of work or employment. The noun form of {勤|つと}める (to work at, to be employed). Refers to working for a company or organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧{勤|つと}め⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: My father works at a bank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧{勤|つと}め⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Have you been working at the company long?

examples.japanese: {勤|つと}め⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.notes: {勤|つと}め⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ = place of employment

notes:
USAGE: This kanji ({勤|つと}め) emphasizes employment at a company or organization. Different from ⟦{務|つと}め→務め：03438_tsutome⟧ which emphasizes duty or responsibility.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{勤|つと}め (working at ~): ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧{勤|つと}め (bank employee), ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧{勤|つと}め (company employee)
- {勤|つと}め⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (workplace, employer)
- {勤|つと}め⟦{人|にん}→勤め人：noentry⟧ (office worker, salaried worker)
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{勤|つと}め (polite: one's work)

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{務|つと}め→務め：03438_tsutome⟧:
- {勤|つと}め - focuses on employment, working for someone
- ⟦{務|つと}め→務め：03438_tsutome⟧ - focuses on duty, obligation, role

Both are read つとめ but have different nuances.
